name: Swell AI
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Swell AI, generate show notes, articles, social posts, and transcripts from uploaded episodes. The hard boundary is templates, integrations, hosted processing, and content history, plus audio infrastructure, distribution, and production polish.
